description:
**Deprecated.** This endpoint is deprecated and will be removed on 2027-11-17.
Use `PATCH /rest/v1.1/budget_line_items/{id}` instead.

Update a line item of a specified budget.

id.description: Unique identifier for this budget line item. Use as the {id} path parameter for the Show and Update endpoints.

original_budget_amount.description: Original budgeted amount for this line.

uom.description: Unit of measure for the line's quantity (e.g., hours, each, sq ft). Any value from the company's configured Units of Measure list.

quantity.description: Budgeted quantity in the line's unit of measure. Multiplied by unit_cost when calculation_strategy is 'automatic' to become the original_budget_amount.

unit_cost.description: Cost per unit of measure. Multiplied by quantity when calculation_strategy is 'automatic'.

calculation_strategy.description: How original_budget_amount is derived, such as entered directly ('manual') or computed from quantity and unit_cost ('automatic').

approved_budget_changes.description: Sum of approved budget changes applied to this line.

revised_budget.description: Current budget after approved budget changes (original_budget_amount plus approved_budget_changes).

pending_budget_changes.description: Sum of budget changes that are proposed but not yet approved.

projected_budget.description: Forecasted budget including both approved and pending budget changes.

committed_costs.description: Total costs committed against this line through commitments such as purchase orders and subcontracts.

direct_costs.description: Total direct costs (e.g., invoices, expenses, timecards) recorded against this line.

pending_cost_changes.description: Sum of cost changes that are proposed but not yet approved.

projected_costs.description: Forecasted total cost at completion, including committed costs, direct costs, and pending cost changes.

budget_modifications.description: Net amount transferred to or from this line via budget modifications. Positive when funds are transferred in, negative when transferred out.

budget_forecast.description: Forecasted budget amount for this line, used when projecting costs over the schedule.

estimated_cost_at_completion.description: Estimated final cost of this line when work is complete.

projected_over_under.description: Projected budget surplus or shortfall (projected_budget minus projected_costs). Negative values indicate an expected overrun.

cost_code.description: Cost code this line item is budgeted against.

id.description: Unique identifier of the cost code.

name.description: Human-readable name of the cost code.

code.description: Short cost code segment for this level.

full_code.description: Fully qualified cost code including parent segments.

division.description: Root cost code (division) that groups this line item.

id.description: Unique identifier of the division (root cost code).

line_item_type.description: Line item type (cost type) categorizing this line, such as Labor or Equipment.

id.description: Unique identifier of the line item type.

name.description: Human-readable name of the line item type.

currency_configuration.description: Currency in which this line item's monetary amounts are denominated.

currency_iso_code.description: ISO 4217 currency code for the line item's amounts.

cost_code_id.description: ID of the cost code to budget this line against. Must belong to the project or one of its sub jobs.

line_item_type_id.description: ID of the line item type (cost type), such as Labor or Equipment. Must belong to the project's company.

original_budget_amount.description: Original budgeted amount for this line, before any budget changes.

uom.description: Unit of measure for the quantity, such as hours. Must be a value from the company's Units of Measure list.
enum: Any value present in the Company list of Units of Measure

quantity.description: Budgeted quantity in the unit of measure. Used with unit_cost when calculation_strategy is 'automatic'.

unit_cost.description: Cost per unit of measure. Used with quantity when calculation_strategy is 'automatic'.

calculation_strategy.description: Determines how the budgeted amount is derived for this line.

direct_costs.description: Direct costs recorded against this line. Include only when the Direct Costs tool is turned off for the project.
